title: guard-main refuses a read-only look at a queue file
what: guard-main refuses only commands that write a queue file (open with a write mode, redirection into .relay/queue, sed -i, mv, rm, tee), not reads.
why: 28 Oct: `python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.relay/queue/<slug>.json')); print(d.get('closed_at'))"` in the main checkout was refused: 'a queue item is changed only by relay queue'. The command only reads. A read is the cheapest way to get one field; `relay queue show` prints the whole item. Principle 10: a refusal for a harmless step costs a turn.

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)
